title: how we work lives in the store, so any method can be checked against it quickly

criteria.text: Every rule of how we work is a record with scope process, its why, the dated failure as evidence, strength and the enforcing check
criteria.note: 100 practices loaded from the seed, 6 absolutes left to their own records (#1243 PR body) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F128.1 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-practices.test.ts` and `supabase/tests/knowledge_practices.sql`, so no. Reviewed: #1243 reviewed, but #1355 and #1362 (seed edits) carry no `Reviewed by:`, so no.

criteria.text: Ask how something runs: "how does our DevOps work" returns a short answer from live records, each line linked to its record and enforcing check
criteria.note: `how` verb with `area_words` in #1243 [V]. Checked: `[guards F128.2]` in `tests/knowledge-practices.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Drift shows itself: a weekly job flags any practice whose enforcing check or workflow no longer exists
criteria.note: Step added to `knowledge-drift.yml` (Mondays 16:41 UTC), `scripts/knowledge/practice-drift.ts` [V]. Checked: only `[guards F128.3 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-practices.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Review a method in one session: claims (at most 15) each marked do, opposite on purpose, gap or clash, with one experiment; no web research
criteria.note: `review_method` verb returns the steps and the pack and fetches nothing (#1243) [V]. The review itself is an agent procedure. Checked: only `[guards F128.4 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-practices.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Every practice has a ring (adopt, trial, assess, hold); moving a ring writes a new version with its why
criteria.note: `ring` column, moved only through `revise` (#1243) [V]. Checked: `[guards F128.5]` in `supabase/tests/knowledge_practices.sql`.

criteria.text: Experiments are records: practice changed, baseline, measure, verdict date, verdict; the single-loop plan's changes come in first
criteria.note: `experiment` kind, 8 experiments loaded (#1243) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F128.6 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-practices.test.ts` and `supabase/tests/knowledge_practices.sql`.

criteria.text: The monthly upkeep lists practices not confirmed in 90 days and experiments past their verdict date
Docs follow the store: after a week side by side, `socialus-ops` `process/` docs are generated from the records
criteria.note: Not built [V]: PR body 'Criterion 8 ... follow-up #1244'. #1244 (open) waits a week after the first import that loads practices.

criteria.text: One pack for a chat project: a Markdown pack of how we work (under 10,000 tokens, dated, sized) plus a review-a-method file, written to `socialus-ops` on change and monthly
